ideas.prompt: Use sound as process rather than data as the hidden rule for a section. reduce the musical notes and let the sound behaviour carry the psychedelic detail. Let the listener feel the behaviour before they understand the technique. Name the patch after the behaviour, not after the plug-in.
ideas.neonOrbitUse: Translate Andy Farnell's procedural-audio thinking into a Neon Orbit move: the sound should behave, respond or evolve instead of sitting still.

ideas.prompt: Create a contrast pair from amplitude-dependent waveshaping: one dry/simple version and one animated/procedural version. give the sound an origin, a body and a destination, even if all three are imaginary. Use the difference as the section's hook. Give the drummer or live arrangement one clear cue for when it should open up.

ideas.sourceBook: Designing Sound
ideas.sourceConcept: bells, bouncing, rolling, creaking and boing
ideas.prompt: Build a object gesture where bells, bouncing, rolling, creaking and boing becomes audible in one small decision: start with a plain source, then automate only one behaviour until the sound seems alive. Keep it testable inside an eight- or sixteen-bar Neon Orbit section. Give the drummer or live arrangement one clear cue for when it should open up.
ideas.neonOrbitUse: Use this as a sound-design lab card for Ableton, Max for Live, MicroFreak-style modulation, guitar resampling or field-recording transformation.
